reason: Both give the correct safety stop, ask the sensible timing question and point to the heater element as the likely cause without certainty. Conversation 1 explains more usefully what the engineer will do, namely an insulation or resistance test of the element to earth, then a check of the pump and wiring if the element tests fine, which fits the 'confirm by test' approach. Conversation 2 is more generic, and its line that the machine 'needs to be isolated immediately' adds little. Neither asks for the model number or tests the other-circuit trip, so the gap between them is small.
